title: A label behind a box is hidden
hook: Which layout exposes the written addresses?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that a label only helps if it faces you while the box sits on the shelf

recall.question: Six opaque boxes sit on a shelf with their labels on the back faces. From the front, how many labels can you read without moving a box?
recall.why: Opaque boxes hide their rear faces from the front view, so 0 labels are visible. Turned to the front, all 6 are. Where the label sits is part of the address.
